question: Why did the error rate go up on 26 March 2026?

contributing_factors.description: New deployment caused the error rate to increase.
why_chain: The deployment of catalog v1.24 to eu-west led to a change in error rate.
The deployment occurred 273 minutes before the change in error rate.
The error rate increased from 0.33% to 0.74% after the deployment.

contributing_factors.description: The deployment may have introduced a bug.
why_chain: The deployment of catalog v1.24 coincided with the increase in error rate.
The error rate increased after the deployment, but the request volume and latency remained stable.
There is no clear evidence of a bug in the deployment itself.

ruled_out.hypothesis: The increase in error rate was due to a sudden increase in user traffic.
ruled_out.reason: The request volume and latency remained stable, indicating no sudden increase in user traffic.

ruled_out.hypothesis: The increase in error rate was due to a configuration change.
ruled_out.reason: The deployment of catalog v1.24 was the only change in the system, and the error rate increased after the deployment.

evidence.summary: Error rate for service catalog in region eu-west rose from 0.33% to 0.74% (+126%), with a change point at 2026-03-26T10:45:00Z.
The change is concentrated in service catalog in region eu-west: 1 of 12 service/region segments changed; the other segments stayed flat (largest after/before ratio 1.01).
At the same time, request volume for service catalog in region eu-west stayed about the same (563 per 5 min before, 697 per 5 min after, +24%).
At the same time, p95 latency for service catalog in region eu-west stayed about the same (120 ms before, 119 ms after, -0%).
Deployed catalog v1.24 to eu-west (catalog, eu-west; 273 min before the change; record R013)

reasons: ✗ The closest change event is 273 min before the change, too far to be convincing.
✗ No logs or alerts from the affected segment confirm the problem.
✓ Request volume stayed steady, ruling out a traffic spike.
✓ No competing change event fits as well.
✓ The main factor rests on this event.
missing_data: Change records from the hour before the change
Error logs or traces from the affected segment after the change

actions.action: Roll back the deployment of catalog v1.24 to eu-west.
Implement automated monitoring for error rates and request volumes to detect anomalies early.
Review and test the deployment of catalog v1.24 in a staging environment before production.
